products.name: Gong
products.note: Revenue intelligence AI; call analysis; deal coaching; sensitive sales data exposure

profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA, that describes itself as a Revenue AI operating system for go-to-market organizations. The company's platform is built around what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built sales applications, with stated use cases including deal coaching, pipeline risk prediction, automated handoffs, churn prediction, and scaled enablement.

Gong's named products include Gong Engage, which the company describes as a tool for prioritizing and personalizing sales communications, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer module the company says grounds sales training in real customer conversations. The site also references an AI Tracker agent, which a quoted customer credits with lifting buyer response rates by 32%, and cites a separate customer claim of 6,700 hours saved across call preparation, follow-up, and CRM updates. The site notes capabilities for customer success teams as well, framing AI as a tool for reducing churn and driving expansion.

The held facts note that Gong's product involves handling sensitive sales data, a consideration the site itself does not address directly. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
